question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **"Hieararchy."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"Hierarchy."**
 
• It is a noun that refers to a system or organization in which people or groups are ranked one above the other according to status or authority. (श्रेणीबद्घ संस्‍था अथवा प्रणाली, निम्‍न-उच्‍चक्रम, अधिक्रम, पदानुक्रम)
 
 
• **Example**: *The company's **hierarchy**__ was clearly defined, with the CEO at the top and the interns at the bottom.*

• **Option 3: "Ignorance"** is spelled correctly. It is a noun that refers to a lack of knowledge or information. (सूचना या ज्ञान का अभाव; अज्ञान)
